title: Penglai Pavilion

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified public elevation field at the pavilion approach on the Danya Hill crown.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap enclosure and measured pavilion dimensions from Shandong heritage and Penglai county gazetteers.
mapIdentity.scope: Named Danya Hill enclosure and measured gallery footprints from the Shandong and Penglai gazetteers. The verified 1925 plate sets the approach silhouette.

note: The 1925 plate shows the layered roofs and terrace. County and heritage records establish two storied galleries with 16 perimeter columns at each level, gray tiles, flanking rooms and stone access stairs. The upper roof is a hipped gable.
